[Layout] asymmetric: a brush-script headline stack on the upper left, pine and ribbon detail entering from the top right, one large glossy bauble hanging into the lower right, a rectangular date chip mid-left, a thin rule and short sign-off under it, QR block bottom right. [Typography] hand-brushed calligraphy for the main lines, small clean sans for the secondary lines, mono capitals for the date chip. [Subject] single lacquered crimson bauble with a gold cap and a soft gold ribbon curling through fresh fir needles over a blown-out autumnal bokeh background. [Lighting & mood] backlit, airy, calm and reflective. [Details] shallow depth of field, delicate highlights on the glass, generous white space. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "DEC 25".

title: Merry Christmas Scooter Greeting Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, cinematic 3D render with shallow depth of field. [Colors] Twilight blue sky (#26456E), emerald scooter (#2E8B63), Santa red, warm window amber and snow white. [Layout] A small date tag top right, a large flowing script headline across the upper third with a bell and bow beside it, a two-line wish beneath, and the hero scooter filling the lower half in profile, with a contact strip along the bottom. [Typography] Elegant connected script with long swashes in white and gold, plus a bold condensed sans for the wish lines and thin caps for the footer. [Subject] A round Santa in a red suit riding a vintage mint-green scooter, a tall stack of wrapped green and red gifts strapped behind him, cruising a snowy village street lined with garlanded lamp posts and glowing timber houses. [Lighting & mood] Dusk light, warm shop-window glow, falling snow with bokeh, shallow focus, whimsical and cinematic. [Details] Chrome scooter trim and mirrors, gold baubles in the air, snow banks along the curb, garlands on the eaves, glowing tree in the distance. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "12.25".

title: Merry Christmas Storybook Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, richly detailed storybook illustration. [Colors] Cinnabar #C0272C sky, pine #2F6B45, gold #EEC25C, snow white #FBF8F1, sky blue #9EC6DE. [Layout] The upper third holds an oversized two-line sans headline in warm cream with a small date tag at the top right and a thin side note; the tree fills the centre and lower frame, its tiers sheltering small characters tucked among the branches; two snowmen and a bell mascot stand on a snowbank at the foot; a blue gift and a wrapped parcel sit right of centre; a contact row closes the bottom edge. [Typography] Bold geometric sans with generous tracking, a light condensed serif for the small date. [Subject] Dense fir with piping garlands and striped baubles, a smiling Santa, snowman, gingerbread figure and reindeer nestled in the boughs. [Lighting & mood] Gentle glow from the lights, painterly snow, warm festive abundance. [Details] Falling snow, glossy ornaments, soft fur trim, dimpled snow. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "12.25", "HAPPY HOLIDAYS".

title: Minimal Letterpress Christmas Party Invitation
prompt: Christmas party invitation, vertical, in a restrained minimal-type letterpress finish. [Colors] Pale warm grey (#F1F0EC) stock, charcoal ink (#33383C), one muted red for the handwritten line, soft sage-grey for the painted tree, faint blush and stone dots. [Layout] A centred typographic column with wide margins: a small bracketed tag top right, a big brush wordmark, a script sub-line, oversized serif invitation lines, a thin ruled guest-name line, and TIME and ADD blocks stacked at the lower third with a small painted tree bottom right. [Typography] Expressive dry-brush capitals for the opening word, high-contrast serif for the title, small letter-spaced capitals for labels, generous line spacing throughout. [Subject] A loosely painted grey-green tree dotted with red blossoms, alone on the page — everything else is type and air. [Lighting & mood] Flat daylight, calm paper texture, hushed and elegant. [Details] Scattered pale polka dots bleeding off the edges, hairline dividers, wide-tracked footer line; three text elements: "WELCOME", "CHRISTMAS PARTY", "DEC 25 · 6–9PM".

title: Minimalist Christmas Greeting Poster with Gold Glitter Tree
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, minimal-type design with a glitter gradient form. [Colors] Pale ice blue to misty aqua gradient (#CFE4E2 to #A9CFCB), champagne gold glitter (#E8CE86), muted teal for the small deer figure, warm brown-grey type. [Layout] Centred axis: a small logo pill at the very top, one spaced tagline set as two short phrases split by a small x mark, the glitter triangle tree in the upper middle, a large Latin greeting, a short stacked word, a tiny tree icon, and address lines at the base above a legal footnote band. [Typography] Thin extended sans in wide letterspacing for the greeting, hairline serif for the small tagline, tiny caps for the footnote. [Subject] A tall soft-edged triangle of gold glitter with a bright star at its apex, a small standing deer silhouette inside the lower part of the triangle, thin snowflakes drifting around. [Lighting & mood] Airy, cold, calm, almost weightless. [Details] Soft grain in the gradient, faint horizon haze, generous negative space. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "SEASON'S GREETINGS".

title: Minimalist Christmas Tree Invitation Poster
prompt: Christmas invitation poster, vertical, cut-silhouette minimal type on a flat red field. [Colors] brick red #A8201F, forest green #1D5B44, glitter gold #E8C36A, cream #F6EEDC. [Layout] a huge triangular fir silhouette rises from mid-page to the apex, a glitter star floats above its tip, the three-line invite stacks inside the upper third of the tree, two logistics rows with round icons sit near the base, and a strung bauble garland crosses the silhouette's widest point. [Typography] bold condensed sans in cream for the invitation, an outline display face for the season line, light sans for the date and venue. [Subject] the tree reads as one flat cut shape with a softly flocked edge, sparse gold dots and thin hand-drawn sparkle strokes around the star, a small wrapped gift tucked at the lower right. [Lighting & mood] festive and graphic, poster-flat with a whisper of foil shine. [Details] halftone speckle in the red field, starburst rays behind the star, rounded gold baubles on a thin cord. Text: "YOU'RE INVITED", "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "DEC 1-30".

title: Romantic Pastel Christmas Greeting Card
prompt: Christmas greeting card, vertical, in a soft-focus pastel still-life photography finish. [Colors] Dusty rose and blush (#EFC3C4, #F7DDDA) dissolving into cream, champagne gold accents, bright white snow; the only saturated note is a warm gold script. [Layout] An airy left-aligned text stack occupies the upper half with generous leading, a gold calligraphic signature floats right above the props, and the lower third is a low still-life in fresh snow with a frosted pine sprig pushing in from the right edge. [Typography] Light modern sans-serif in white with wide leading for the verse, plus one flowing gold script line as the only decoration. [Subject] Two rose-pink baubles — one sugar-glittered, one matte — resting in snow beside a small glowing star lamp and a dusted pine branch. [Lighting & mood] Shallow depth of field, warm string-light bokeh blooming into soft circles, romantic and gentle. [Details] Fine falling snow specks, no border, abundant negative space, subtle film grain; two text elements: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "12/25".

title: Starlight Christmas Night Market Poster
prompt: Christmas fair long-scroll poster, vertical, flat illustrated scroller for a holiday night market. [Colors] holly green #2E7D5B ground, cream #F7F3E6 panel, Santa red #D32F2F, butter yellow #E9C25B. [Layout] stacked sections down the page: an oversized cream title cropped at both edges, a line of small caps beneath it, a giant Santa face peeking over the panel rim, an information panel with a centred date row and three short lines, a green ribbon tag naming the event, a paragraph column, and a reindeer-and-sleigh vignette at the bottom. [Typography] heavy rounded display sans for the title, wide-tracked small caps for the English line, regular sans for the details. [Subject] flat vector Santa with a huge white beard, closed smiling eyes and a red bobble hat, both hands gripping the panel border; below, a leaping reindeer pulling a tiny sleigh. [Lighting & mood] cheerful flat illustration, market-day bustle, generous white space. [Details] gold bells, holly sprigs, snow dots, dotted rules, scalloped panel edge; text "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "DEC 24 – DEC 25", "STARLIGHT NIGHT MARKET".

title: Winter Snow Globe Festival Poster
prompt: Professional winter festival poster, vertical, photoreal composite with a glass snow globe hero. [Colors] Glacier blue #2C5C8F to violet #6A5C9E night gradient, ice white #F2F8FF, warm amber #E9A94F lantern glow. [Layout] Full-bleed sky with the globe on a pedestal low centre, a date pill at the top, a two-line title above the globe, tagline below it, then a contact row and code along the base. [Typography] Clean geometric sans in white, thin-bracketed subtitle, small caps inside the date chip. [Subject] A crystal snow globe holding a frosted ice castle, tiny pine forest, two miniature skaters and a snowman on a snow mound; outside the glass, snow-laden spruce branches and a lit lantern frame the scene. [Lighting & mood] Cold blue ambient with warm interior glow, crisp winter air, magical and serene. [Details] Etched snowflake ornaments, sparkle glints on the glass rim, drifting flakes, subtle blue lens bloom. Text: "ICE & SNOW FESTIVAL", "JAN 5", "WINTER WONDER".

title: Cozy 3D Gingerbread Christmas Greeting Card
prompt: Vertical Christmas greeting card in a cosy 3D gingerbread still-life finish. [Colors] Honey biscuit #B5763F, royal icing white #FBF6EF, deep red #9E1220 envelope, forest green #2C6141, blush fondant pink, gold script #D8AE62. [Layout] Upper two thirds a close crop of a gingerbread house with a warm bokeh tree behind; lower third a red envelope card opened flat with a pale wax seal, holding an intimate letter block; a thin contact strip at the very bottom. [Typography] Refined serif for the headline set vertically along the right edge, small sans for the letter, an elegant script for the closing signature. [Subject] A richly decorated gingerbread house with icing icicles, candy-glass windows, pretzel and gumdrop trim, tiny fondant figures and a sleigh in front, cream satin ribbon and a soft wax seal on the envelope below. [Lighting & mood] Soft window light, shallow focus, homemade warmth. [Details] Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "WITH LOVE". Sugar grain texture, crumb detail, gentle vignette.

title: Cozy Christmas Living Room Illustration Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, single-column composition on warm cream paper. [Colors] Off-white ground #F7F1E6, deep fir green #2E4A38, oxblood line red #8C2A24, one mustard star #E0A63C. [Layout] Centred stack: a hand-lettered headline at the top with a small circular date badge to its left and a leaf sprig beside it; a tall block of thin-line body copy sits mid-right as a counterweight; the lower half is one continuous ink drawing of a living room, with a small tree at the left, fireplace with mantel candles in the middle and a wing chair plus stacked ribboned gifts at the right, all resting on the bottom edge with generous margins. [Typography] Brush script English headline paired with a narrow serif, hand-drawn numerals in the badge, airy line spacing in the copy block. [Subject] A single-colour gesture line illustration of a cosy Christmas corner, hatching used only for shadow under the fire and the gifts. [Lighting & mood] Flat ambient daylight, no gradients, quiet and nostalgic like a sketchbook page. [Details] Sparse snowflake glyphs in the corners, small cross marks, an uneven hand-inked baseline; text limited to "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "2025.12.25". Finish: hand-drawn white-line sketch.

title: Expressive Gouache Christmas Tree Poster
prompt: Christmas poster, vertical, expressive gouache painting. [Colors] oxblood red ground #8E1B1B, sage and emerald brushstrokes #4F7A52, butter yellow star, candy pink, cobalt and orange baubles, off-white type. [Layout] a tall vertical headline column on the left with a rotated Latin line beside it, the tree centred inside a hand-drawn swirling ellipse, gifts at the base, a date block and one short line lower-left, small oval badges upper right. [Typography] bold condensed sans set vertically, a slanted handwritten Latin line, small serif numerals. [Subject] a thick-brush fir with snow clumps, a gold garland swirl, a candy cane and gingerbread ornaments, three wrapped presents resting on a snow patch. [Lighting & mood] warm, painterly, hand-made and nostalgic. [Details] text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "DEC 25, 2025"; visible brush edges and dry-brush gaps, spattered snow, red paper grain, soft drop shadow under the tree.

title: Felt Board Christmas Invitation Flyer
prompt: Professional Christmas invitation flyer, vertical, felt board letterpress feel. [Colors] Grass green #4C8B3F fur, ivory #F6F0DC felt board, holly #1F5A34, cherry #C2242C, mustard #EFB33C. [Layout] A plush santa peeks over the top edge of a stitched cream board filling the centre; the board carries the wordmark, an invitation line with a small bell, a short centred message, a date block, a rounded green call-to-action pill and a QR square; felt tree and stocking frame the lower corners. [Typography] Red embroidered script for the wordmark, hand-set sans for the message, small caps for the date. [Subject] Fuzzy felt characters: santa with pom-pom mitten hands, a stitched stocking on the left, a soft tree with a smiling face and pom-pom baubles on the right. [Lighting & mood] Even daylight, craft-fair warmth, soft tactile shadows. [Details] Blanket-stitched border, wool fibre texture, stitched holly sprigs, tiny snow dots on the green fur. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "YOU'RE INVITED", "2025/12/25".

title: Luxurious Gilded Christmas Greeting Poster
prompt: Vertical Christmas greeting poster, gilded luxury still life. [Colors] Crimson (#A61E2A-#C0282F), champagne gold (#E0B45C), ivory (#FBF3E2), soft gold glitter. [Layout] Centred type stack in the upper third, a wide empty red field around it, props bleeding in from all four corners, a small logo lockup at the very top and a contact block at the bottom. [Typography] Very wide-tracked thin serif capitals as the hero line, a tiny doted lowercase line above it, hairlines flanking a small bell icon. [Subject] Gold and red baubles, a knitted stocking with a white snowflake, a wooden reindeer, a candy-striped gift box tied with a satin star, pine sprigs, all arranged as a loose wreath around the type. [Lighting & mood] Warm frontal light, glinting metallic highlights, shallow shadows; opulent, festive, traditional. [Details] Text elements: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "SEASON'S GREETINGS". Paper fibre texture, tiny gold confetti, soft vignette, crisp product-level rendering.

title: Luxury Gold Ribbon Christmas Tree Greeting
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, luxury still life. [Colors] Deep crimson #8E0E1A grading to #C0182A radial glow, champagne gold #E8C87A, rose gold #D9A46B, warm honey light #FFD9A0. [Layout] A wide engraved headline band crosses the top third on a mirrored gold hairline rule with a scroll terminal; the hero sculpture stands centred on a wet reflective table that doubles its image; two gift boxes flank the bottom corners, half out of frame; a thin contact strip closes the base. [Typography] High-contrast didone capitals with a swash script line layered over them, small letterspaced caps for the date, hairline rules separating the bands. [Subject] A conical tree built from one continuous spiral of satin gold ribbon, densely dusted with glitter that throws sparks, crowned by a small burst of light; brass bells and a red-and-gold parcel rest at its base. [Lighting & mood] Low-key dramatic rim light, glowing bokeh specks drifting in the dark, opulent and celebratory. [Details] Faint star flares in the upper field, mirror reflection under the ribbon, glitter settling on the table grain; text limited to "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "2025.12.25". Finish: gold-foil ribbon sculpture.

title: Winter Museum Christmas Gala Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas event poster, vertical, photographic interior inside an illustrated ornament frame. [Colors] oxblood #9B1B1E border, antique brass #C79A52, sepia stone #B49A72, cream #F7EFE1. [Layout] decorative white swirl frame inset from the edge, holly-and-bell badge centred at the top, a two-line headline with a ribbon subline above a wide date band, a sepia architectural photograph filling the middle with a lone figure on a balcony, contact lines and QR at the base. [Typography] soft rounded display with a slight outline for the headline, condensed numerals for the big date, small sans for schedule and ticket price. [Subject] Victorian museum hall with iron arches, stone staircase and tiled floor, small decorated firs flanking the date band. [Lighting & mood] nostalgic, grand, warm tungsten tone. [Details] hand-drawn border ornaments, torn paper edge at the bottom, print-grain overlay. Text: "WINTER MUSEUM", "DEC 25 · 4–10PM", "$12 ADMISSION".

title: Elegant Gold Foil Christmas Greeting
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, flat vector illustration with gold-foil linework. [Colors] deep maroon #7A1023 to #5A0B18 gradient, leaf green #3E7B4F, pine shadow #2C5B3B, metallic gold #E6C069. [Layout] symmetrical: an arched gold headline curving across the top, a small tracked date beneath, a centred tree with a star topper and swept gold garland trails exiting both sides, a bordered quote plate low centre, QR and logo at the foot. [Typography] chunky gold display letters set on an arc, thin monospaced numerals, small serif for the quote. [Subject] stylised fir built from layered leaf clusters, red ribbon garland, rounded ornaments, gift boxes at the base, scattered gold stars. [Lighting & mood] warm, elegant, greeting-card calm. [Details] flat shading with crisp gold outlines, star-shaped sparkles, even grain. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS", "DEC 15".

title: Joyful Santa Christmas Greeting Poster
prompt: Professional Christmas greeting poster, vertical, airbrushed 3D cartoon. [Colors] soft periwinkle #B7C8F0 to lilac #D9C6EE sky, cotton white #FBFBFD snow, Santa red #D6362F, mint #BFD9C8 trees. [Layout] small script line at the very top, oversized white headline across the upper third, hero character centred and mid-air, supporting characters flanking the lower corners, wish block across the bottom. [Typography] rounded soft sans headline in white, tiny script accent, spaced small caps footer. [Subject] a beaming Santa leaping forward with a bulging sack and stacked gifts, a reindeer with a red nose at left, a scarf-wearing snowman at right, pastel village behind. [Lighting & mood] soft high-key daylight, fluffy pastel gradients, joyful and gentle. [Details] airbrushed shading, rounded volumes, tiny snow sparkles, soft contact shadows. Text: "MERRY CHRISTMAS".
